title: THE RUCK · LOADED INCLINE
why: Zone 2 day with teeth: a 30-minute incline walk that gets interrupted every 5 minutes by a loaded leg. Nothing from Mon, Tue or Thu repeats. First Tonal stations.

blocks.title: THE RUCK · 30:00 · 3.5 MPH / 10%
blocks.meta: Zone 2 · nose breathing · step off every 5:00 for one loaded leg, then straight back on
blocks.format: Walk 3.5 mph at 10% for 30 minutes. At 5, 10, 15, 20, 25 and 30 minutes, pause the belt, do the leg listed, step back on. Belt speed never changes. If nose breathing breaks, drop to 8%.
blocks.workRest: Next week: 11% if all 6 legs were done with the belt at 10%.

items.name: 5:00 · Waiter march 35 lb 20 steps/side
items.detail: bell locked out overhead, knees high

items.name: 10:00 · Tonal pullthrough ×12
items.detail: rope between the legs, hinge, snap the hips; find the weight that makes rep 12 hard

items.name: 25:00 · Leopard crawl 2 × 10 yd
items.detail: knees an inch off the floor

blocks.title: PUSH-UP EMOM · 6:00
blocks.meta: 6 minutes · a different push-up each minute · rest the remainder
blocks.format: Top of each minute, do the push-up listed. Score = minutes finished with 20 s left.
